description: Send Kai a short note on a live call it is making for the person, to steer it: a detail to mention, a question to add, a preference. Kai uses it on its next turn without reading it out. It never overrides Kai's honesty and disclosure rules. Up to 10 notes a call.

note.description: What Kai should know or do, in one or two sentences (up to 500 characters)
